description: 0^0, 1^NaN, NaN^0, 0^-1, negative bases with fractional exponents, overflow, [12].
reference: torch.pow(a, b) in f64, rounded once to f32
notes: Expected NaN must be NaN (any NaN matches any NaN) and expected ±inf must be the same inf. pow(1, NaN) = pow(NaN, 0) = 1, as in PyTorch and C. out is computed in f64 from the inputs and rounded once to the dtype under test, so the bytes don't depend on the CPU's vectorized kernels; torch in the dtype itself meets the tolerance (checked by the generator).
